numerical_failure.observed_behavior: scipy.special.hyperu(a,b,x) gives output values that are extremely off (off by several magnitudes) for x close to 0 when a is close to 0 and b=1; e.g. with a=0.1, b=1 the errors appear near x=0.01 compared with mpmath.hyperu. No error message is raised, just a miscalculation.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: hyperu(a,1,x) should match mpmath.hyperu(a,1,x) for small a and small x; the reference values in the regression test are compared with assert_allclose at rtol=1e-13.
trigger_conditions: a close to 0 (small |a|, roughly -0.25 < a < 0.3 region covered by the fix)
x small and positive (0 < x < 1, e.g. around 0.001 to 0.05; errors appear near x=0.01 for a=0.1)
a not close to 0 (e.g. |a|>0.5) does not show the error

input_output_examples.buggy_output: value off by several magnitudes from mpmath (exact buggy number not given in passages)
input_output_examples.expected_output: mp.hyperu(0.1,1,0.01) from mpmath (exact number not given in passages)

oracle_clues: assert_allclose(sc.hyperu(a, b, x), expected, rtol=1e-13) in scipy/special/tests/test_hypergeometric.py test_gh_15650_mp
Fix uses DLMF 13.3.7: (x + 1 + 2*a)*hypU_wrap(a + 1, 1, x) - (a + 1)**2 * hypU_wrap(a + 2, 1, x) for b == 1 and x < 1 and -0.25 < a < 0.3 in scipy/special/_hypergeometric.pxd

numerical_characteristics.precision: Regression test uses assert_allclose(sc.hyperu(a, b, x), expected, rtol=1e-13); reference values computed with mpmath at mp.workdps(100)
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: b == 1, small |a| (|a| < 0.25 in the test region; -0.25 < a < 0.3 in the patch condition), and 0 < x < 1; the issue reports errors near x=0.01 for a=0.1 with x between about 0.001 and 0.05
category_specific_evidence: Issue #15650 reports hyperu(a,b,x) off by several magnitudes for a close to 0, b=1, and small x, with no error message.
The issue reports no such errors for |a| > 0.5.
The reference comparison in the issue is mpmath's hyperu.
The patch applies DLMF 13.3.7 when b == 1 and x < 1 and -0.25 < a < 0.3, using hypU_wrap(a + 1, 1, x) and hypU_wrap(a + 2, 1, x).
Regression test test_gh_15650_mp draws a from uniform(-0.25, 0.25) and x from logspace(-5, -1), with expected values from mpmath hyperu at 100 digits.
An earlier discussion proposed the condition abs(a) < 1 and abs(x) < 1 for the DLMF 13.3.7 branch, and said the threshold was later picked more carefully.
reproduction_risks: The dtype is not stated in the passages; the defect is not shown to depend on float32 versus float64, so dtype is left null.
The patch condition differs between the applied diff (-0.25 < a < 0.3) and the earlier discussion (abs(a) < 1 and abs(x) < 1), so the exact region is unclear.
The passages do not give the buggy output or the exact error magnitude for a=0.1, x=0.
